_comment: Operator overlay on data/context/personas.json. That file is RESEARCH, regenerated monthly by agents/voice-of-customer — edit it and the change silently reverts, and authored copy becomes indistinguishable from mined evidence. Retirements and operator-authored angles live here instead. Applied at load by agents/ad-brief and the dashboard's ad-brief route via lib/operator-angles.js. This file is NEVER written by an agent.

retired.label: 125 chemicals a day
retired.why: Unrenderable for two independent reasons, and its score of 81 — the highest on file — made that invisible. (1) THE NUMBER IS WRONG. '125+' traces to a single customer's own figure in a lotion review, not to a study. The real source is EWG: 126 unique ingredients in 2004, revised DOWN to 112 in their 2023 re-run (see brand-kit.json's category_ingredient_load). So the angle cited a stale number AND stated the trend backwards. (2) THE FRAMING IS A HEALTH CLAIM. Its proof and source_quotes run on 'cleaning up your health', 'toxic chemicals' and 'what goes on skin goes into the bloodstream' — systemic-absorption and toxicity claims a cosmetic may not make, which is what the copy writer kept reaching for. Replaced by p2a4, which keeps the ingredient-count contrast and drops the toxicity. Retired rather than edited: rewriting a mined angle in place would make authored copy look like customer research.

angles.label: 112 ingredients, or one
angles.authored_why: Replaces retired p2a2. Same job — the unaware reader who has never counted what goes on their skin — rebuilt on a real, current, citable statistic and on an INGREDIENT-COUNT contrast rather than a toxicity claim. 'Chemical' is not a synonym for 'harmful' and saponified coconut oil is one too; the contrast that actually differentiates this catalogue is how MANY, not how dangerous. Every figure below is a contiguous verbatim substring of brand-kit.json's category_ingredient_load, so it is sourceable as brandKit.
angles.objection_addressed: 'I have never actually thought about how many different ingredients I put on my skin in a morning.'
angles.proof: The average adult uses 12 personal care products a day, made with as many as 112 unique chemical ingredients, per an EWG / Morning Consult survey of 2,200 U.S. adults in 2023. Pure Unscented is saponified organic virgin coconut oil and nothing else — one ingredient against a routine that averages 112.
hook_examples: 12 products. As many as 112 unique chemical ingredients. Before you have left the house.
Count the ingredients in this morning's routine. Now count this bar's.
The average adult's day starts with 12 personal care products. This is one ingredient.
source_quotes: The average adult uses 12 personal care products a day, made with as many as 112 unique chemical ingredients — EWG / Morning Consult survey of 2,200 U.S. adults, 2023
